We need to determine crimes from facts.

Facts: Li was drunk driving (blood alcohol 136.55 mg/100ml). That's over 80 mg/100ml, qualifies as drunk driving. In Chinese law, "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) is the crime for drunk driving. So "危险驾驶" is the crime.

Also, Li had prior conviction for "过失损坏军事通信罪" (negligent damage to military communications). He was in probation period and reoffended with new crime. The fact mentions that he committed new crime while on probation. The new crime is drunk driving. So only one crime? Possibly also "酒后驾驶" is "危险驾驶罪". The prior conviction is not a new crime, just context. So only "危险驾驶". However sometimes they also charge "酒后驾驶" as "危险驾驶罪". So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶<eoa>
